🍬 Candy Shop is OPEN every Friday and this week DJ Ralphy Ray is back behind the decks turning Azucar into the sweetest, loudest spot in Pasco. 🎧

Think bass that hits like sugar rush, a room dripping in neon candy vibes, and a crowd that doesn't stop moving till close. This is the night you circle on your calendar and tell your whole group chat about.

Lollipops, Skittles, and straight fuego sounds — Candy Shop is quickly becoming THE Friday habit in the Tri-Cities. Pull up, get your fix. 🍭

And the deal? Ladies free before 11PM. $5 cover for everybody else. That's it. That's the whole move. Doors swing open at 9PM and this place doesn't slow down till 2AM.

Candy-colored lights, shots lined up like a rainbow, and a crowd ready to turn Pasco into the party capital of the Tri-Cities. Every Friday it's a new flavor, a new vibe, same unforgettable energy. 🍬
